```{r}
levmar_linear <- function(x, y, beta0, lambda0=1e-3, v=10, 
                          tol=1e-4, max_iter=100) {
  n <- length(y)
  p <- length(beta0)
  beta <- beta0
  lambda <- lambda0
  history <- list(beta0)
  
  rss <- function(b) sum((y - x %*% b)^2)
  
  r0 <- y - x %*% beta
  sigma2_hist <- sum(r0^2)/n
  loglik_hist <- -n/2*log(2*pi*sigma2_hist) - sum(r0^2)/(2*sigma2_hist)
  lambda_hist <- lambda
  
  J <- x      
  JtJ <- t(J) %*% J             
  
  for (s in 1:max_iter) {
    r <- y - x %*% beta
    A <- JtJ + lambda * diag(p)
    delta <- solve(A) %*% (t(J) %*% r)
    beta_new <- beta + delta
    
    if (rss(beta_new) < rss(beta)) {              
      r_new      <- y - x %*% beta_new
      sigma2_new <- sum(r_new^2)/n
      ll_new     <- -n/2*log(2*pi*sigma2_new) - sum(r_new^2)/(2*sigma2_new)
      
      history[[length(history)+1]] <- beta_new
      sigma2_hist <- c(sigma2_hist, sigma2_new)
      loglik_hist <- c(loglik_hist, ll_new)
      lambda      <- lambda / v
      lambda_hist <- c(lambda_hist, lambda)
      
      if (sqrt(sum((beta_new - beta)^2)) <= tol) {
        beta <- beta_new
        break
      }
      beta <- beta_new
    } else {                                      
      lambda      <- lambda * v
      lambda_hist <- c(lambda_hist, lambda)
    }
  }
  
  list(beta=beta, history=history, sigma2=sigma2_hist,
       loglik=loglik_hist, lambda=lambda_hist, iter=length(history)-1)
}
```
